checks.name: A caregiver adds a word from a phone photo; the picture is cropped square and stored on the device only
Duplicate labels and non-image files are refused with Kinyarwanda messages
The new word appears in its category on the board with its own photo, and Erekana still works without speech
A familiar-voice recording makes the custom word speak, and its message is kept off the server
Deleting a custom word removes it, its recording and its place on every board
A 9-cell grid shows fixed 3 x 3 pages; turning a page is logged as a navigation action
The last page keeps the grid shape with empty slots, and tiles stay at least 2 cm on a phone
A 40-cell grid fits the whole everyday page, and "Byikora" fits the grid to a tablet and a phone with no page scroll
Personal suggestions need word suggestions on and lift a word this child uses after "I"
The vocabulary review shows the sheet words one at a time, in order, with their voice
Closing the review leaves no trace: no message, action or vocabulary change is stored
Vuga says I + want + water as the sentence “Ndashaka amazi.”, Erekana shows it, and want alone stays “gushaka”
With “Vuga interuro yuzuye” off, the same pictures are spoken word by word again
With next words on, “kunywa” opens drinks (cup, juice, milk) in the grid; one choice returns to the same page without navigation taps
A caregiver changes the pictures after “kunywa” for this child and can restore the starting list
A chosen place puts its words first on the board, core words after them, and opens on its first page
Each picture is said as soon as it is tapped, and a caregiver can switch that off and on
With the section tabs turned off, the caregiver picks the section, or every picture in pages, and can bring the tabs back
Keys show the picture with its word on top, and a caregiver can choose pictures only
The final-feature workflow raised no uncaught page errors
A sideways swipe turns the page without choosing a picture, a tap straight after still chooses, and a caregiver can switch swiping off
